title: Tracking order
reconnecting: Reconnecting… this page may be a moment behind.

closed.contactRestaurant: Please contact the restaurant if you were not expecting this.

reasons.cardExpired: The card payment wasn’t completed within the {minutes} minutes allowed, so the order was cancelled automatically.
reasons.cardSetupFailed: The card payment couldn’t be set up, so the order was cancelled. Your card was not charged.
reasons.slipRejected: The restaurant couldn’t accept your transfer slip.
reasons.customerCancelled: You cancelled this order before it was paid.
reasons.kitchenRejected: The kitchen couldn’t take this order.
reasons.kitchenCannotMake: The kitchen can’t make this order.
reasons.noRider: No delivery rider was available for this order.
reasons.duplicate: This order was a duplicate of another one.

driver.finishingOtherDelivery: Your driver is finishing one nearby delivery first
driver.collecting: Your driver is collecting your order
driver.onTheWay: Your driver is on the way
driver.locationStale: Location last updated {age} — the map and ETA may be behind

cardPayment.payBody: Your order goes to the restaurant as soon as the payment goes through. Pay within {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} or the order is cancelled.
cardPayment.preparing: Getting the secure card form ready…
cardPayment.paidBody: Your payment went through and the restaurant has your order.
cardPayment.processingBody: Your bank is confirming it. This page updates on its own — there is no need to pay again.
cardPayment.failedBody: Try again with the same card or another one.
cardPayment.expiredTitle: The time to pay has run out
cardPayment.expiredBody: This order was not paid within {minutes} minutes, so it is being cancelled. Nothing was charged. Place a new order when you are ready.
cardPayment.payAtRestaurantBody: This order was placed before card payments were taken online here. Please pay when you collect your order or when it arrives. Your order is not cancelled.
cardPayment.refundedBody: {amount} has been sent back to the card you paid with. Banks usually show it within 5–10 business days.
cardPayment.refundingTitle: Your refund is on its way
cardPayment.refundingBody: A refund of {amount} to the card you paid with is being processed. Once it goes through, banks usually show it within 5–10 business days.
cardPayment.refundFailedBody: The refund to your card couldn’t be completed. Please contact the restaurant so they can sort it out.
cardPayment.partlyRefunded: {amount} of this payment has been refunded to your card.
cardPayment.securedNote: Paid securely through Stripe, straight to the restaurant.

reasons.authentication: The card’s verification was not completed.
reasons.processing: The card could not be processed.
reasons.generic: The payment did not go through.

errors.unavailable: This restaurant can’t take card payments online right now. Please contact them to pay another way.
errors.expired: The time to pay for this order has run out.
errors.notPayable: This order no longer needs a card payment.
errors.tooSmall: This amount is too small to pay by card.
errors.inProgress: A payment for this order is already under way. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.generic: We couldn’t load the card payment. Check your connection and try again.

transfer.confirmedBody: The restaurant has checked your slip and started your order.
transfer.rejectedTitle: Your transfer slip was not accepted
transfer.waitingTitle: Waiting for the restaurant to check your slip
transfer.rejectedNoReason: Please upload a clearer photo of the transfer.
transfer.waitingBody: We will start your order as soon as they confirm it. This usually takes a few minutes.
transfer.reviewBody: Have a look at the photo below. Replace it if it is not right, then confirm you have paid — that is what sends it to the restaurant.
transfer.payBody: Scan the code, transfer the total, then upload a photo of the confirmation.
transfer.confirmPaid: I’ve paid — send to the restaurant

errors.fileType: Please upload a PNG, JPEG or WebP photo of your slip.
errors.tooLarge: That image is larger than 10 MB.
errors.uploadFailed: The photo did not upload. Check your connection and try again.
errors.notYourOrder: We couldn’t find this transfer on your account. Sign in with the account you ordered with.
errors.slipRequired: Upload a photo of your transfer before confirming.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

actions.cancelPrompt: Changed your mind? Nothing has been prepared yet — the restaurant has not confirmed your transfer, so you can still call this order off.
actions.cancelPromptCard: Changed your mind? Your card payment hasn’t gone through and nothing has been prepared, so you can still call this order off.
actions.contactToChange: Need to change or cancel this order? Please contact the restaurant directly — they can update it for you while it’s still being prepared.

cancelErrors.signIn: Please sign in with the account you ordered with to cancel this order.
cancelErrors.otherAccount: This order belongs to a different account. Please contact the restaurant to cancel it.
cancelErrors.tooLate: This order has moved on and can no longer be cancelled here — please contact the restaurant.
cancelErrors.generic: That didn’t go through. Please try again, or contact the restaurant.
cancelErrors.cardPaid: Your card payment has gone through, so only the restaurant can cancel this order now. Please contact them; they will refund your card when they cancel it.

rating.thanksBody: Your feedback helps the restaurant get even better.
rating.driverFirst: Rate your rider first — the restaurant is next.
rating.driverOnly: Rate the rider who brought your order.
rating.foodLast: Last step — how was the food itself?
rating.foodOnly: Rate the food to finish up.
rating.driverPlaceholder: Anything to say about your driver? (optional)
rating.foodPlaceholder: Anything to say about the food? (optional)

errors.signIn: Please sign in with the account you ordered with to rate this order.
errors.noAccount: This order isn’t linked to an account, so it can’t be rated.
errors.saveFailed: Couldn’t save your rating. Please try again.

issue.sent: Thanks — the restaurant has been notified.
issue.sendFailed: Couldn’t send your report. Please try again.

chat.title: Chat with your driver

chat.unread: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}
chat.pastRiderGone: That rider is no longer on your order.
chat.closesWhenDone: Chat closes when the delivery ends.
chat.archiveError: Could not load the earlier conversation.

photoErrors.unsupportedType: That file is not a photo we can send. Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
photoErrors.tooLarge: That photo is too big. Try taking a new one.
photoErrors.prepareFailed: Your browser could not prepare that photo. Try another one.
photoErrors.uploadFailed: The photo did not upload. Check your signal and tap to retry.
photoErrors.generic: Could not send that photo. Tap to retry.
